The entire exact-identity layer survives and is now doubly verified: master identity p*#irred_4 = C - p^4 (p>=5; p=3 needs the -(Q-p) zero-polynomial correction) [proved]; linearization Tr(t theta^p)=Tr(t^{1/p} theta) [proved]; |V_t| = p^{p-2} for all t in kerTr\0 [proved]; u=v=0 stratum = p-1 = the excluded Artin-Schreier orbit [proved; I re-derived via c^{(Q-1)/(p-1)}=c]; u=0,v!=0 strata = chi(-1)^{(p+3)/2} p^{(3-p)/2} A' = #irred_2-(p-1) [proved; I re-derived every step incl. the identical w-cancellation on kerTr, eta|F_p^* = chi, and the Hasse-Davenport sign G_Q=g_p^p; verified A'=100 -> 20 at p=5]; slice decomposition #irred_a = p^2 - p^{3-p} + p^{2-p}R_a with my independent recomputation giving R = (-620,+630,+630,-620) at p=5, matching brute force for every a [proved]; exact ledger #irred_4 = (p-1) + p(p-1)N(p) + (p-1)(p^2-p^{3-p}) + p^{2-p}sum_{a!=0}R_a and the implication [|sum R_a| < (p-1)(p^p-p)] => Target [proved; arithmetic checked]. The alpha=0 strata sum to exactly #irred_2 (the briefing's contrary main-term claim is false; both agents agreed and I confirm). Symmetries: #irred_a depends only on chi(a) and p | #irred_a [proved] -- STRENGTHENED HERE: the involution f(T) -> -f(-T) fixes each a-slice (a,b,c,d)->(a,-b,c,-d), acts freely on b=0 irreducibles (fixed points d=0 are divisible by T), so 2p | #irred_a for a != 0, p >= 5; every slice count in all datasets is even, confirming this new theorem.
NEW STRUCTURAL RESULTS FOUND DURING ADJUDICATION, which overturn both agents' asymptotic readings: (i) For x in F_p, f(x) equals the cubic tail ax^3+(1+c)x+d, so the F_p-root (linear-factor) structure of every family member is EXACTLY the splitting of its cubic tail; the number of rootless (c,d) per (a,b=0)-slice is exactly (p^2-1)/3 [proved, verified p=5..17], vs the random-poly rate e^{-1}: the family carries a deterministic 'singular-series' density factor with leading term (1/3)e ~ 0.906. (ii) Extended slice counts (my independent Frobenius-ladder scan to p=181, agreeing with the prior N3 sweep at EVERY jointly computed prime; combined validated data to p=293, 60 primes, 120 slice values) obey cnt_{b=0}/p = 0.842 + 0.618/sqrt(p) + noise, with residuals standardized by the pair-Poisson variance 2p having mean 0.000, variance 0.83, |z|<=2.8, and NO trend in p (slope 0.004). The same logic predicts the quadratic family's mean N(p) ~ (1/2)e*corr ~ 1.2, exactly as observed (1.18 over 238 primes). CONSEQUENCE: E[R_a] ~ (sigma(p)-1)p^p ~ -0.16 p^p is a DETERMINISTIC secondary main term at critical scale with definite negative sign (candidate closed-form origin: local factor statistics of the sparse family), while the FLUCTUATION is at the smaller scale ~p^{p-1/2} (pair-Poisson), decaying relatively like p^{-1/2}. This refutes the cubic writeup's empirical model ('R_a ~ random signs at p^p, non-decaying, individual-sign problem like N(p)>=1') -- its evidence (max 0.54 at p=13) was small-p noise plus the then-invisible drift -- and refines the adversary's Poisson picture (right scale, but variance is 2p from pairing, and the drift exists; their z=-4.88 at p=167 is drift, not a tail event). Also refuted: writeup sec.6's 'typical |E_a(t)| ~ p^{(p+1)/2}': measured rms|E_a(t)| = 0.39 sqrt(Q) at both p=5 and p=7; and I proved E_a(t^p)=E_a(t) exactly (Frobenius invariance in t). The quadratic route is confirmed dead: N(p)=0 at 31,41,59,71,97,113,131,151,157,163 in my independent scan (61/238 primes <=1499 per the prior checkpoint, consistent on all overlaps).

(2) GAMMA-AVERAGING / FROBENIUS-TWIST TRICK: UNSOUND -- independently derived. At fixed t, gamma = wt + t^{1/p} ranges only over the p-point affine line t^{1/p} + F_p t, never over F_Q, and alpha=ut, beta=vt co-move with t, so no complete gamma-sum at fixed (alpha,beta) exists anywhere in the family. L_w(t)=wt+t^{1/p} maps kerTr to kerTr and is bijective iff w != -1 (kernel F_p at w=-1; verified ranks 4,4,4,4,3 at p=5 -- the adversary's 'rank-deficient at w=4' IS w=-1, so the two reports do not even disagree). Structurally decisive: the phase is linear in t, so every complete t-average over the subgroup kerTr is a Plancherel delta reconstructing the unknown count (first moment = p^{p-1} r(u,v,w), verified; second moment = p^{p-1} N_corr with the forced diagonal). The two reports' 'conflicting' second-moment numbers are literally the same fact: N_corr = (p+1)Q - p + E = p^{p+1} + (Q-p) + E; at (u,v,w)=(2,4,1), p=5 I recomputed sum_t|W|^2 = 11,434,375 and N_corr - p^{p+1} = 2670 = (3125-5) + (-450). RMS|W| = sqrt(Q) exactly; Cauchy-Schwarz returns the trivial bound. No exact rearrangement of the ledger can close the gap.

(3) EXACT RESIDUAL GAP. Minimal clean lemma (Lemma E): for every prime p >= 5 (needed exactly when N(p)=0, ~26% of primes): there exist u in F_p^*, v,w in F_p and theta in F_{p^p}\F_p with theta^p + u theta^3 + v theta^2 + w theta in F_p. [Then f = T^p+uT^3+vT^2+wT-(value) is the degree-p minimal polynomial of theta, hence irreducible with a != 0; so Lemma E <=> some a!=0 slice positive => Target.] Sufficient analytic form (Lemma L, confirmed correct): |sum_{a!=0} R_a| < (p-1)(p^p - p); the empirical truth is ~0.16(p-1)p^p (factor ~6 margin), the provable trivial bound is p^{p-3} too large, and the required saving over per-term Weil on the u!=0 aggregate is a factor ~2p^{p/2-1} (the briefing's 'p^{1/2+eps}' was wrong; the writeup's ledger arithmetic is right). NEW, sharper well-posed target arising from this adjudication: prove the singular-series asymptotic #irred_a = sigma_a(p) p^2 (1+o(1)) with sigma_a(p) bounded below -- the deterministic component now has a candidate local-statistics derivation (leading factor (1/3)e from the exact cubic-tail root localization), reducing the problem to any o(p^p) bound on the fluctuating part of R_a; that error bound is still the square-root-cancellation-in-growing-dimension wall (codim-4, degrees<=4, bilinear-phase sum in A^{2p}; Betti constants exponential in p; dynatomic degree 3^p), unreachable by current technology.

(4) OVERALL VERDICT: HARD-BUT-WELL-POSED. Not theorem-in-reach: the elementary/moment/equidistribution toolbox is provably circular or insufficient (agreed by both agents and confirmed), and cohomological closure needs constants ~p^2 where general bounds are exponential in p. But NOT the same wall as the quadratic criticality in the strong sense claimed by the cubic writeup: the truth has a stable positive density sigma ~ 0.84-0.91 with a derivable leading constant, failure requires an ~sqrt(sigma p/2)-sigma downward fluctuation (~10.5 sigma already at p~200, growing like sqrt(p)) plus the exact quantized event I_+ = I_- = 0 (each in 2pZ) AND N(p)=0; the Target is doubly machine-verified for all p <= 293 (my independent scan to 181 agreeing with the cross-validated sweep everywhere; no zero slice anywhere; explicit witnesses at quadratic-failure primes confirmed, e.g. T^97+T^3+1 and p=401 (1,0,10,58)). Most promising residual routes, in order: (a) prove the local/singular-series main term with power saving (new formulation); (b) fixed-dimension mass formulas (Stickelberger/discriminant character sums over the 4-dim family) to exclude the exact vanishing event; (c) the constructive dynamical route (f = T^p - g(T) irreducible iff x^p = g(x) has a g-composition-period-p solution; proof re-derived and confirmed).

P=3 RULING: the briefing's family-equality claim (iii) is FALSE at p=3 (deg-3 m with lead 2 collapses degree; also theta^3 is Frobenius at p=3, linearizing the 'cubic' phase and voiding the Weil bound), and the master identity needs the -(Q-p) correction; but this is immaterial: FF-Fortune(3,1) is unconditionally PROVED -- every deg-1 m fails (f(x)=ax+b on F_3 always has a root; re-derived), deg-2 witnesses exist (6 of them; T^3+T^2-T+1 verified irreducible), witnesses are automatically coprime to P_1, and reducible deg-2/3 m must have a linear factor, so the minimal nonconstant m has degree 2 and is irreducible. Correct handling: state all machinery for p >= 5 and cite the p=3 base case as separately proved. Both agents handled this correctly in substance; the adversary's classification 'repairable' is right.

fatal_flaws: Briefing's cubic-ledger plan is unsound as stated: the alpha=0 (exactly evaluable) strata do NOT contain the p^3 main term -- they sum to exactly #irred_2, which vanishes for the ~26% of primes with N(p)=0; the main term lives in the u!=0 cubic-Weil aggregate, which no stratum supplies for free (confirmed against both agents and by independent computation).

Briefing's error budget is wrong by an exponential factor: the needed saving over per-term Weil on the u!=0 aggregate is ~2p^{p/2-1} (essentially full square-root cancellation over the (p-1)-dimensional t-space), not p^{1/2+eps}.

The gamma-averaging/Frobenius-twist 'decisive trick' is structurally impossible: gamma ranges over a p-point line at fixed t, alpha and beta co-move with t, and L_w(t)=wt+t^{1/p} (bijective on kerTr iff w != -1) never decouples the arguments.

All exact t-average/moment methods are circular: the phase is linear in t, so subgroup averaging is a Plancherel delta reconstructing the unknown count; the second moment is diagonal-dominated with RMS|W| = sqrt(Q) exactly, so Cauchy-Schwarz returns the trivial bound with zero gain (verified to the digit at p=5).
The quadratic (a=0) family cannot carry the theorem: N(p)=0 for 61 of 238 primes <= 1499 (independently confirmed at 10 primes up to 163); any proof must produce cubic (a != 0) witnesses.

The cubic writeup's asymptotic diagnosis is wrong: its 'exactly critical, non-decaying random-sign R_a ~ p^p' model (and its claimed typical |E_a(t)| ~ p^{(p+1)/2}) is refuted by extended data; the critical-scale component is a deterministic negative secondary term (~ -0.16 p^p, with a derivable local-statistics origin) and the noise decays relatively as p^{-1/2}. Misdiagnosing this as an individual-Kloosterman-sign problem would misdirect future work; the real analytic target is a singular-series main term with any o(p^p) error.

Cohomological closure is blocked at growing dimension: the isolated error is a bilinear-phase character sum over a codim-4, degree <= 4 variety in A^{2p} needing square-root cancellation with constant <= p^2, while general Betti/complexity bounds are exponential in 2p, and the dynatomic model has degree 3^p; no rearrangement of the elementary ledger avoids this wall.
